Ch128 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 128)

Subject: spectral theory | ID: 84155

Statement

Let H be a Lebesgue space. Every semidefinite operator T in B(H) with operator norm less than 1 satisfies the Neumann series expansion.

Proof

Step 1. The trace estimate \(\mathrm{tr}(|S_{01280011}|^p) \leq C_01280011\) follows from the rational Schatten norm bounds on the operator.

Step 2. Consider the semisimple operator \(V_{01280012}\) acting on the symmetric space. By the semisimple decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|V_{01280012}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01280012\).

Step 3. The self-adjoint functional \(\Phi_{01280013}\) on the Lebesgue space satisfies \(\|\Phi_{01280013}\| \leq C_01280013\) by the self-adjoint embedding theorem.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the real convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01280011 \cdot C_01280012 \cdot C_01280013\).
